title: [serialization] Isolate temporary safe globals by context
body:
Temporary safe_globals entries previously modified the process-wide allowlist, allowing unrelated concurrent loads to use them and nested contexts to remove entries still needed by their callers. Keep temporary entries in an immutable context-local stack while retaining process-wide add_safe_globals behavior. Clearing the allowlist also clears the current context's entries without restoring them when nested contexts exit.

Test Plan
```
cd /private/tmp
/Users/admin/project/AI/pytorch/agent_space/conda-env-safe-globals/bin/python /Users/admin/project/AI/pytorch/agent_space/run_safe_globals_tests.py
```
All five regression cases passed using the modified allowlist definitions and test methods with an existing PyTorch runtime, not a full source build. Four cases failed against the original definitions in the baseline run.
